amalfi-coast-ravello-balcony.title: Amalfi Coast · Ravello Balcony
amalfi-coast-ravello-balcony.slogan: A 91 km loop out of Sorrento
amalfi-coast-ravello-balcony.story: The SS163 is barely wide enough for the buses that use it, which is exactly why a motorcycle is the right vehicle here. Ride it at first light and it is one of the great coast roads; ride it at noon in August and it is a car park with a view. Ravello above it is the quiet alternative.
